data.name: Falaagam
data.gender_notes: Falaagam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Falaagam is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu deity Indra. It means 'Lord of Sacrifice'. In Hindu mythology, Indra, the god of rain, is known to be a fierce warrior and a patron of warriors. Falaagam signifies the strength, courage, and sacrifice that a warrior embodies. The name Falaagam carries the meaning “Lord of Sacrifice” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Falaagam usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of sacrifice and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes strength, courage, and sacrifice in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Falaagam belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Sacrifice.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Falaagam total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
